import json, sys
import mod.client.extraClientApi as api
factory = api.GetEngineCompFactory()
assert not hasattr(sys, '_shield_frame_camera_v5_r20')
sys._shield_frame_camera_v5_r20 = {'step': 0}
cam = factory.CreateCamera(api.GetLevelId())
target = (3.5, -57.5, 3.05)
camera = (3.5, -57.5, -1.0)
rot = api.GetRotFromDir(tuple(target[i] - camera[i] for i in range(3)))
cam.DepartCamera()
cam.LockModCameraPitch(True)
cam.LockModCameraYaw(True)
assert cam.SetCameraPos(camera)
assert cam.SetCameraRotation((rot[0], rot[1] + 180., 0.))
_result = json.dumps({'target': target, 'camera': camera, 'pose': 'front', 'top_ui': api.GetTopUI()})
